_note: ANT WORK 5 voice script. id -> {who, text}. [brackets] = not spoken. Render: python3 tools/voices.py

x_1.text: Jay... are we dead? Is this what dead is?

x_2.text: No. I think... the watch broke something. Look at the sky.

x_3.text: Half of it is night. Half of it is day. That's not a thing!

x_4.text: That's the saloon. From Dustreach. And that's... the pig king's spoon?

x_5.text: Every place we've ever been. Stitched together wrong.

x_lab1.text: [whisper] Jay. That's Steve. And Alex. Their lab got sucked in too.

x_lab2.text: [whisper] Stay out of that blue light. Use the boxes.

x_s1.text: FREEZE! ...Oh, it's YOU. Of course it's you!

x_s1b.text: YOU! You did this! You and that stupid watch!

x_s2.text: Steve. Look around. Shouting won't fix any of it.

x_a1.text: It isn't from any reality. Not yours, not ours. It's from outside.

x_a2.text: Beyond. Something made it. And that something will want it back.

x_join.text: Come with us. Nobody gets out of here alone.

x_s3.text: ...Fine. But if this goes wrong, I'm blaming you.

x_a3.text: We'll come. Somebody has to be the adult.

x_away.text: Stay away from us. Both of you.

x_s4.text: Ha! Go on, then. Let's see how far you get without us.

x_c1.text: The tear. Up on that cliff. That's the way out, I can feel it.

x_c2.text: Those rocks are stuck in a loop... the watch. Maybe I can stop time.

x_w_2.text: There's no floor. We're floating. Jay, we're FLYING.

x_w_3.text: Look. Boxes. Glass boxes. And there's... places, inside them.

x_desert.text: The desert. Jim's stand. That's where it all started.

x_niv.text: Nivalis. I can still feel how cold that cave was.

x_gulch.text: Dry Gulch. And that's... a grave.

x_time.text: That's not a place. That's time. All of it, spinning.

x_thing1.text: DON'T LOOK AT IT! Jay, don't look at it!

x_thing2.text: I... I can't stop looking. It's looking BACK.

x_jim1.text: Ahh, this is the life. No ants. No stand. Just me and the...

x_jim2.text: ...Jay? Is that you? And... another you? In the SKY?

x_jim4.text: Man. I need a better vacation. Go away. Both of you.

x_door.text: A door. Out here, in nothing. Something wants us to go in.

g5_1.text: Little ones. You carry something that belongs to me.

g5_2.text: I am what is outside your sky. I made every box you passed. Every reality.

g5_3.text: And I made that. The watch. A small thing. It slipped through my fingers... and fell into one of my worlds.

g5_4.text: Your Jim found it in the sand. And it chose you.

x_b2.text: Wait. So you're just... a guy who lost his watch?

g5_6.text: Choose your next words carefully, little one. You have so few of them left.

x_b3.text: JAY! Put him down! PUT HIM DOWN!

g5_home.text: Wise. Go home, little ones. Forget the boxes.

x_home1.text: There you two are! Where have you BEEN? The ants ate half the stand!

g5_keep.text: [laughs] Then keep it. And wander. Every reality, forever. You will never find home again.

x_e_fix.text: [choking] Fix it. All of it. Bring Bob back.

g5_fix.text: Everything has a price. Bob lives. But someone must keep my boxes.

x_e_alex.text: Take me instead. I know what you are. Let them go.

x_alexbye.text: Go, Jay. Steve... look after them.

x_e_j2.text: Take ME. I'm the clone. I'm the extra one. Let him go home.

g5_j2.text: A copy who chooses. I did not make that. ...Very well.

x_j2bye.text: Hey. Tell Jim I said hi. And... thanks for coming back for me. Every time.
